# Temporal child 3 agreed producer seam (implementation contract)

Parent owns TemporalExposure, TemporalGrid, TemporalConcentration, temporalquery changes and ADR0019.
Child3 worker will own NEW align/temporalprojection.scala, NEW codec/temporalprojection.scala,
MappingExchange additive extension, MappingPipeline typed facade extension, dedicated tests, fixture
producer, independent Python reader and handoff. No edits to imported workspace semantics.

Core API contract:
TemporalProjection.Request(selection: TemporalSupport.Selection,
 declarations: Vector[TemporalQuery.Declaration], bins: Vector[(Long,Long)],
 overlap: TemporalExposure.Overlap = Refuse, recallWindow: Option[RecallWindow] = None).
RecallWindow(clock: Checksum, start: ExactRational, endExclusive: ExactRational) is untrusted input.
TemporalProjection.compile(mapping: MappingResult, measure: TemporalQuery.Measure,
 request: Request, timing: Option[RecallTiming]): Either[Refusal, TemporalProjection].

Compile validates requested source selection/axis, disjoint in-bounds bins, duplicate/unknown source
declarations, supplied timing inventory and recall-window clock. Filter known declarations to each
unit's actual measured targets before prepare (unselected measured targets stay unavailable).
Per-unit failure or missing measure remains an explicit row; no silent dropping. Shared regions are
built once. TemporalGrid now stores sparse Maps for cells, allocated and bounds; zero values derive
from shared regions. No dense unit-by-bin matrix. Preserve all original per-unit ledgers/statuses.
Projection binds mapping, inventory, segmentation, selection, axis, declarations/allocation, query/grid,
measure, timing/exposure and overlap in identity. Expose timing NotRequested/Missing/Provided truthfully.
When a recall window is requested and timing supplied, use checked TemporalExposure.query. Retain
per-unit duration and sparse duration-times-quantity cells separately from original weights. Failed
units retain uncomputed duration. Never normalize or call inverse contributions reverse posterior.
Clock uncertainty is explicitly not modeled; categorical decomposition NotAssessed; no joint authority.

Codec is additive canonical temporal-projection/v1. Existing MappingCodecs records stay authoritative.
Encode exact ticks/rational integers as decimal strings and canonical binary64 values. Contextual
decode takes live mapping+optional timing and rebuilds the full projection, compares all fields; do not
trust rehashed summaries. Never derive live execution authority from imported workspace JSON.

MappingExchange extension accepts owning MappingRun.Execution and typed projections for both members,
checks exact reference/reconstruction mapping digests and normalized-score/posterior measure kinds,
adds temporal files to existing member files under a NEW pair-with-temporal schema version. Legacy
encode/decodePair byte behavior unchanged. Contextual decode rebuilds against owning execution.

MappingPipeline exposes typed per-Run and per-Batch requests using supplied/prepared timing. Batch
keeps every attempted observation including failures/missing timing, with cohort counts independent
of successful temporal projection. export uses existing disclosure and atomic resume guards. CLI
reads ordinary study/mapping/temporal-request files (exact integer parsing), generates paired exports;
no bench dependency. Consumer fixture/generator binds exact producer SHA, schema/query version and
expected values, with narrow/broad/peaks/disjoint/point/untimed/external/failed/repeated/>2^53 cases.
Independent Python Fraction reader verifies actual emitted region/grid values and refuses rehashed
corruption and lossy JSON numeric ticks. StoryAtlas browser gate remains a separate consumer obligation.

Before implementation, a separate-package consumer contract test must fail on the absent API. Parent
will run it after current serialized full gate; worker can prepare test and inspect callers first.
